arguments.root_cause_statement: Service search in namespace search selects pods with the label app=search-api, but the search Deployment stamps its pods with app=search. No pod in the namespace carries app=search-api, so the endpoint controller populates no addresses for the Service and its Endpoints object has no subsets. The web-gateway pod resolves the search Service ClusterIP but every connection has no backend behind it, so its calls to the search backend fail and shoppers get the "search is unavailable" fallback. The two search pods themselves are Running, Ready and serving on :8080; only the Service's label selector is wrong.
